messages:
mike-samples: Heads-up — spotted a copy/paste drift in the sample-app README that keeps tripping up new users. The install line still says `npm install @redwood/sdk` but the published package is `@redwood/inference-sdk`. Folks get Module not found.

mike-samples: Current bad snippet:
```bash
# in README
npm install @redwood/sdk
node sample-app.js
```

olga-support: saw 3 tickets this week where devs followed the quickstart and hit "Cannot find module '@redwood/sdk'". They assume our SDK isn't published.

omar-sdk: Also the sample-app's config section omits region/private endpoint instructions. Dedicated/private customers end up hitting the hosted endpoint and get 403s. We need a short note showing how to set REDWOOD_REGION or REDWOOD_PRIVATE_ENDPOINT.

anya-devex: Agreed. Minimal fixes: 1) update install to `npm i @redwood/inference-sdk` and add a yarn variant, 2) add a one-line region/env example, 3) show how to switch to private endpoint. I'll open a PR.

anya-devex: Proposed replacement in README:
```bash
# npm
npm install @redwood/inference-sdk
# yarn
yarn add @redwood/inference-sdk
```
```js
// sample-app config
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, region: process.env.REDWOOD_REGION })
// For private deployments set: process.env.REDWOOD_PRIVATE_ENDPOINT = 'https://private-cust.example'
```

omar-sdk: Please also pin a supported SDK version in the snippet (`@redwood/inference-sdk@^2.1.0`) and add a one-liner about private endpoints requiring a custom base URL and mTLS in some setups.

mike-samples: I'll add that. +1 on showing both npm/yarn and version pinning. Also propose a tiny CI smoke test: examples/ci should run `npm ci` and `node sample-app.js` against a mock endpoint to catch package-name drift and missing env vars.

ci-bot: created job examples/sample-app-smoke — it spins up mock-server, runs npm ci, and executes sample-app.js with test env vars. Queued.

ci-bot: smoke test run #1 queued by anya-devex. Logs: mock-server responded 200, sample-app logged "ok". :white_check_mark:

olga-support: can we also add a short FAQ blurb in onboarding: "If you see Module not found '@redwood/sdk' please run npm i @redwood/inference-sdk and check your package.json." That will help support triage.

omar-sdk: I'll add a docs-linter rule to flag the old package name in fenced code blocks and fail CI on new occurrences. Regex: /@redwood\/sdk/.

anya-devex: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1542 — fixes install lines, adds region/private endpoint note, pins SDK version, and wires up the sample-app-smoke CI job.

deploy-bot: docs preview created by anya-devex: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/quickstart/1542 (expires in 48h) :rocket:

ci-bot: examples/sample-app-smoke passed on PR branch. docs-linter caught one lingering old-package instance in examples/README and fixed it automatically.

mike-samples: Verified preview and CI. Also added a tiny CHANGELOG entry in the sample-app repo: "fix: correct SDK package name in README". Thanks for the quick turnaround.

olga-support: great — this should cut down the repeated Module not found tickets. Please merge and backfill the onboarding KB.

anya-devex: merging after green CI. Follow-up: schedule a monthly snippet smoke run to proactively catch this class of drift. Closing once merged. :white_check_mark:
